remainingUnknowns: The HEAD 25/26 handbook does not publish per-size data for 143 cm. A Snowleader specialist-retailer page called Easy Joy R + Joy 9 GW SLR (2026) lists 143 cm as 117/70/103 mm and R9.6, with a matching 163 cm reference row, but does not display HEAD article 316485. Keep the row as retailer-sourced supplementary evidence, not manufacturer-confirmed data. A Polish exact-article page is out of stock and has no 143 cm geometry; its 163 cm radius conflicts with HEAD. A Korean exact-article listing provides only 148/153 cm radii.
No current CNY price with verifiable China-market availability was found. Foreign market listings are evidence for product/article matching only, not a China retail price.
The official 2025/26 standard Easy Joy article 31565501 has per-length data, but differs from rental article 316485 and must not be substituted.
The geometry represented by the 163 cm reference row remains a single reference-size specification, not proof that other lengths share those dimensions.
